headline: Are Wall Street Analysts Predicting ON Semiconductor Stock Will Climb or Sink?
summary: ON Semiconductor has rallied the broader market over the past year, and analysts remain moderately optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

headline: STARTRADER expands AI offering with 31 New US Share & ETF CFDs in Semiconductors, Optical Networking & Nuclear
summary: STARTRADER today announced the launch of 31 new US Share CFDs and ETF CFDs, available on the trading platform from August 3 and on the STARTRADER app from August 5, spanning semiconductors, AI infrastructure, optical networking, and nuclear.
